metadata.source: Vision PRD v3.0 - Final Comprehensive Edition, March 2026
metadata.purpose: RAG knowledge base for Structural Intelligence validation protocol

compliance_checks.name: International Building Code
compliance_checks.description: General residential structural compliance per IBC 2021. Governs minimum structural requirements for residential buildings.
rules: Bedrooms must be >= 70 SF with >= 7ft minimum dimension (IRC R304)
Stairs >= 36 inches wide with <= 7.75 inch risers and >= 10 inch treads
Egress windows required in all bedrooms
Maximum 3 stories for Dallas residential (Vision hard cap)
compliance_checks.fail_condition: Any hard constraint violated (stories > 3, missing egress, undersized rooms)

status_logic.PASS: All IBC minimum dimensional and egress requirements met
status_logic.FAIL: One or more IBC minimums violated

compliance_checks.dallas_notes: Dallas residential cap is 3 stories. Mid-rise requires different structural system.

compliance_checks.name: Load Combinations
compliance_checks.description: LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22 / IBC 2021. Six combinations evaluated; governing (highest demand) controls design.

load_combinations.governing_case: Light structures with heavy dead load (concrete, masonry)
MOST COMMON GOVERNING CASE for residential floors
Tall structures, large wall areas, hurricane zones
Lightweight roofs in seismic zones (Dallas = low seismic)
Regions with significant snow (minimal in Dallas)

status_logic.PASS: All six load combinations evaluated; factored demand <= factored resistance
status_logic.FAIL: Any combination produces demand exceeding resistance

compliance_checks.name: Deflection Limit
compliance_checks.description: Serviceability deflection limit per ASCE 7-22. Maximum allowable deflection = span / 360 for live load.

variables.I: moment of inertia (in^4) — from AISC section database

compliance_checks.mitigation: Increase section depth or reduce span if deflection > L/360

compliance_checks.name: Seismic Drift Ratio
compliance_checks.description: Story drift ratio limit per ASCE 7-22 Section 12.12. Dallas is low seismic zone.
compliance_checks.dallas_seismic_context: Dallas = low seismic risk. LC4 (0.9D + 1.0E) rarely governs. Seismic drift check typically passes easily for residential.

compliance_checks.name: Wind Uplift Check
compliance_checks.description: Wind uplift resistance check per ASCE 7-22 Chapters 28-30. Dead load must resist uplift demand.

status_logic.FAIL: Wind uplift demand exceeds dead load resistance

compliance_checks.dallas_notes: Dallas is not a hurricane zone. Wind uplift typically passes for standard residential roof construction.

compliance_checks.name: Foundation Bearing Pressure
compliance_checks.description: Soil bearing pressure check. Actual bearing pressure must not exceed allowable soil capacity.

variables.q_allowable: allowable soil bearing capacity (psf), typical Dallas = 2500 psf

compliance_checks.mitigation: Increase footing area or switch foundation type if bearing pressure exceeds allowable

compliance_checks.name: Snow Load Calculation
compliance_checks.description: Ground and roof snow load per ASCE 7-22 Chapter 7.
compliance_checks.dallas_context: Dallas has minimal snow load. Snow load rarely governs design. LC5 (1.2D + 1.6S + 0.5W) almost never controls.

status_logic.PASS: Roof snow load within design capacity (almost always for Dallas)
status_logic.FAIL: Snow load exceeds roof capacity (extremely rare in Dallas)

beam_analysis.assumption: Simply supported beam, uniformly distributed load
beam_analysis.important_note: Vision uses closed-form analytical solutions only. Do NOT report FEA metrics like mesh density, iteration counts, or convergence plots. This is honest and more appropriate for residential pre-feasibility.

max_bending_moment.units: in-lb when w = lb/in and L = inches
max_bending_moment.description: Maximum bending moment at mid-span for simply supported UDL beam

code_compliance_checks.name: Flexural Strength

variables.Zx: plastic section modulus (in^3) from AISC table

code_compliance_checks.mitigation: Suggest next heavier section from AISC database if flexural utilization > 1.0

code_compliance_checks.name: Shear Strength
code_compliance_checks.mitigation: Suggest thicker web or higher grade steel if shear utilization > 1.0

code_compliance_checks.name: Deflection Serviceability
code_compliance_checks.mitigation: Increase section depth or reduce span if deflection > L/360

code_compliance_checks.name: Soil Bearing
code_compliance_checks.formula: q = R / footing_area <= q_allowable (typically 2500 psf for Dallas)
code_compliance_checks.mitigation: Increase footing area or switch foundation type

code_compliance_checks.name: Wind Uplift
code_compliance_checks.formula: Dead load resistance >= uplift demand (0.9D >= W_uplift)

structural_complexity_index.name: Structural Complexity Index (SCI)
structural_complexity_index.normalize_function: norm(x, min, max) = clamp((x - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)

thresholds.critical: SCI > 8.5 — flag as high structural complexity

hard_blocks.condition: wood_frame AND span > 20ft AND NOT LVL
hard_blocks.reason: Wood framing limited to 20ft without LVL

disclaimer.text: Vision provides pre-feasibility estimates for early-stage planning purposes only. Structural calculations, cost projections, and financial forecasts are advisory and do not constitute licensed engineering analysis, professional design services, or investment advice. All structural design must be reviewed and stamped by a licensed Professional Engineer (PE) before construction.
